description: CRM customer company (Graph Root)
semantic_description: A company or organization record representing a customer or prospect. Central entity linking contacts, opportunities, and service interactions. Accounts are master data with indefinite lifecycle — no status progression, treated as long-lived reference.
lifecycle_description: No status lifecycle — accounts are long-lived master entities. Created with status=active, may be updated or deleted but do not transition through states.

description: Governed directional relationship between two CRM accounts
semantic_description: A single directional relationship edge between two customer accounts, with type, strength, validity and accountable owner. The same edge is visible from both customer endpoints without duplicating facts.
lifecycle_description: Created active, editable while retained, and explicitly deletable. Self-links and duplicate account-pair/type edges are rejected transactionally.

description: Contact person linked to an account
semantic_description: An individual person at a customer organization. Contacts are reference entities linked to an account and may participate in multiple opportunities and activities. LLM need to understand: primary contact flag, contact title, communication channels.
lifecycle_description: Active -> Inactive -> Active. Disabling preserves the contact, relationship and activity history; deletion remains an explicit irreversible action. An active contact may be the account's sole primary contact.

description: Sales lead before qualification
semantic_description: A sales prospect or inquire representing early interest from a potential customer. Tracked from initial capture through contact attempts, qualification assessment, and conversion to an opportunity or loss. LLM need to understand: lead score, source tracking, contact attempt history.
lifecycle_description: NEW → CONTACTED → QUALIFIED → CONVERTED (to opportunity) / LOST (with reason)

description: Lead scorecard rule: one scoring criterion (dimension + condition + points)
semantic_description: A single lead scorecard rule. Each rule defines a scoring dimension (e.g. lead source, industry, requirement length, activity density), a match condition (operator + value), and the points awarded when a lead satisfies the condition. The crm:rescore_lead command sums the points of every matching active rule into the lead's score. Master configuration data, evaluated by the scoring engine, never auto-repaired at startup.
lifecycle_description: ACTIVE → INACTIVE — master configuration. Active rules participate in lead scoring; inactive rules are retained for history but skipped. No mandatory progression.

description: Lead assignment rule: strategy (round-robin / territory / load) mapping leads to sales reps
semantic_description: A lead assignment rule mapping qualifying leads to a sales rep or a rep pool by strategy. round_robin cycles through the rep pool in order; by_territory matches a lead attribute (e.g. industry / region) to a rep; by_load assigns to the rep with the fewest open leads. The crm:auto_assign_lead command selects the highest-priority matching active rule and writes crm_lead_assigned_to. When no rule matches, the command fails loud (no silent fallback to a default rep).
lifecycle_description: ACTIVE → INACTIVE — master configuration. Active rules participate in auto-assignment ordered by priority; inactive rules are skipped. No mandatory progression.

description: Sales opportunity with pipeline stages
semantic_description: A sales deal opportunity representing a qualified prospect progressing through the sales pipeline. Tracked from discovery through proposal, negotiation, and close (won or lost). LLM need to understand: probability %, expected amount, close date, pipeline stage signals.
lifecycle_description: DISCOVERY → QUALIFICATION → PROPOSAL → NEGOTIATION → CLOSED_WON / CLOSED_LOST. May also lose at early stages; can delete only in discovery/qualification.

description: Opportunity-Contact junction table (M:N)
semantic_description: A junction record linking a contact person to a sales opportunity with an assigned role (e.g., decision maker, influencer, technical contact). Supports mapping stakeholders and decision authority within an opportunity pursuit.
lifecycle_description: No status lifecycle — reference relationships. Added when contact engagement in opportunity is identified; removed when no longer relevant.

description: Product/service line items within an opportunity
semantic_description: A line item representing a product or service included in a sales opportunity. Tracks quantity, unit price, cost, discount, and calculated amounts to build opportunity total value.
lifecycle_description: No status lifecycle — child records created/updated/deleted with parent opportunity. Line items may be added/modified during opportunity progress; deleted when product removed from scope.

description: Unified activity: Task, Call, Email, Meeting, Note, Visit
semantic_description: A unified activity record capturing all customer interactions: tasks, calls, emails, meetings, notes, and visits. Each activity has a type, subject, date, and optional assignment. Tasks follow an open → in_progress → done/cancelled lifecycle.
lifecycle_description: For TASK type: OPEN → IN_PROGRESS → DONE / CANCELLED. For other activity types (call, email, meeting, visit): created as OPEN, may be marked complete or cancelled. No mandatory state progression for non-task activities.

description: Activity Association Graph edge linking activities to CRM objects
semantic_description: A graph edge linking an activity to one or more CRM objects (account, contact, opportunity, quote, complaint, etc.). Supports multi-parent relationship; enables activity timeline retrieval from any related entity.
lifecycle_description: No status lifecycle — reference edges. Created when activity is related to an object; removed when relationship no longer relevant. Immutable once created.

description: Customer complaint / service ticket
semantic_description: A customer complaint or service ticket tied to an account and contact. Tracks complaint type, severity, investigation progress, and resolution. Linked to SLA policies for response/resolution time enforcement and breach tracking.
lifecycle_description: OPEN → INVESTIGATING → RESOLVED → CLOSED. Closure requires documented root cause and corrective action. Can delete only in OPEN state.

description: Marketing campaign for lead generation
semantic_description: A marketing campaign representing a planned or active lead generation or customer engagement initiative. Tracks campaign type, date range, budget, and status. Provides context for campaign members and performance metrics tracking.
lifecycle_description: PLANNED → ACTIVE → COMPLETED / CANCELLED. Can cancel from PLANNED or ACTIVE. Deletable only in PLANNED state.

description: Reusable email templates for CRM outreach (follow-up, quotation, etc.)
semantic_description: A reusable email template for CRM outreach: follow-up, quotation request, meeting invitation, etc. Supports template variables for dynamic content. Templates are categorized and may be in draft or active status.
lifecycle_description: DRAFT → ACTIVE (or deleted). Templates start in draft; upon review/approval, activated for use. Deletable when draft; active templates may be archived/deactivated.

description: Log of all sent and received emails related to CRM objects
semantic_description: A transaction record logging all emails (sent or received) related to CRM activities: outreach, follow-up, replies. Tracks direction (inbound/outbound), addresses, template usage, and relationship to CRM objects (lead/contact/account/opportunity/complaint).
lifecycle_description: No state lifecycle — transaction. Created upon email send or receipt. Status field may indicate delivery state (sent, opened, bounced, read) but does not imply mandatory state progression.

description: Links campaign to leads/contacts with engagement tracking status
semantic_description: A member record linking a lead or contact to a campaign with engagement tracking. Supports multiple member types (lead, contact) and tracks participation status (invited, accepted, engaged, unsubscribed, etc.).
lifecycle_description: INVITED → (engagement progression: accepted / engaged / unsubscribed / bounced). Immutable once added unless removed from campaign. Status changes driven by engagement events.

description: Campaign performance metrics: leads, emails, open/click/conversion rates, ROI
semantic_description: A transaction record capturing daily or periodic performance metrics for a campaign: leads generated, emails sent, open/click/conversion rates, cost, revenue, and ROI. Immutable once recorded; supports analytics aggregation.
lifecycle_description: No status lifecycle — transaction record. Created when metrics are measured/recorded for a campaign on a given date. Immutable; corrections require new record with updated date or note.

description: Service Level Agreement rules for complaint response and resolution times
semantic_description: A master SLA policy defining response and resolution time windows for complaint tickets based on priority level. Policies include escalation rules and are linked to complaint records for SLA breach tracking and enforcement.
lifecycle_description: No status lifecycle — master configuration. Policies are created and maintained with is_active flag. Once created, policies are referenced by complaints; deactivation prevents new assignment but does not affect historical records.

description: SLA breach log tracking response/resolution time violations
semantic_description: A transaction record documenting an SLA breach event: which complaint violated which policy, breach type (response vs resolution), when the breach occurred, and associated notes. Used for SLA compliance reporting and escalation.
lifecycle_description: No status lifecycle — immutable transaction. Created when a breach is detected; breach_type indicates response vs resolution violation; notified flag tracks if stakeholders were alerted.

description: Rep periodic forecast commitment (commit/best/pipeline) for manager roll-up
semantic_description: A salesperson's periodic forecast submission stating Commit / Best Case / Pipeline amounts for a period. Monotonic: commit <= best_case <= pipeline. LLM need to understand: forecast category amounts, submission status, period.
lifecycle_description: DRAFT -> SUBMITTED

description: Contact marketing/data consent (GDPR-style opt-in/opt-out)
semantic_description: A contact's consent record per channel. Status: pending/opt_in/opt_out. opt_in requires legal basis + source; opt_out (withdrawal) always allowed.
lifecycle_description: PENDING -> OPT_IN (grant) / OPT_OUT (withdraw)

description: Recurring subscription with MRR/ARR + renewal lifecycle
semantic_description: A recurring subscription. MRR=monthly amount, ARR=MRR*12. Status pending/active/renewal_due(within 30d)/expired.
lifecycle_description: PENDING -> ACTIVE -> RENEWAL_DUE -> EXPIRED

description: Dynamic audience defined by criteria; member count recomputed on demand
semantic_description: A dynamic contact segment. crm_seg_criteria is a JSON array of {field,op,value} (AND semantics); recompute counts matching contacts into member_count.
lifecycle_description: draft -> recomputed (member_count populated)

description: Distributes deal revenue across campaign touchpoints by model
semantic_description: A revenue attribution run. touchpoints=ordered campaign id JSON array; model first_touch/last_touch/linear; result=per-campaign attributed revenue.
lifecycle_description: draft -> recomputed (result populated)

description: Unified omnichannel customer session routed to a queue by channel + tier
semantic_description: An inbound omnichannel session (email/chat/phone/social). route_session assigns queue+priority (phone=urgent, vip=high).
lifecycle_description: open -> pending -> resolved

description: Stateful nurture journey definition with ordered steps
semantic_description: Stateful nurture journey definition with ordered steps
lifecycle_description: draft -> active -> archived

description: A contact's enrollment progressing through a journey's steps
semantic_description: A contact's enrollment progressing through a journey's steps
lifecycle_description: active -> completed / exited

description: Materialized (L1) sales analytics rolled up from opportunities
semantic_description: L1 materialized sales snapshot per period: total/won/won_amount/pipeline/conversion, refreshed from crm_opportunity_common via crm:refresh_sales_snapshot.
lifecycle_description: refreshed on demand / by scheduler

description: Generic customer request bridge before industry-specific routing
semantic_description: A cross-industry customer demand record. It links a lead, account, contact and opportunity to an industry-specific routed object without embedding industry details such as BOM lines, part numbers, supplier costing or PCBA quote lines.
lifecycle_description: draft -> submitted -> routed -> in_progress -> quoted -> won / lost / cancelled

description: Lightweight quote lifecycle summary visible from generic CRM
semantic_description: A generic quote/proposal summary synchronized from a quote fact source such as QuoteOps PCBA quote. It exposes account, opportunity, customer request, amount, status and result to Customer 360 and pipeline reports while keeping line-level pricing facts in the industry quote package.
lifecycle_description: draft / pricing / approval / sent / accepted / ordered / rejected / expired; ordered is recorded only through the released-QDP order-commitment command

description: Cross-domain approval case and audit fact visible from generic CRM
semantic_description: A generic approval case synchronized from domain objects such as QuoteOps quotes. It provides a unified queue and audit record for low margin, high discount, payment term, contract, credit or order exception approvals without embedding industry-specific line facts.
lifecycle_description: pending -> approved / rejected / cancelled, with source object, reason, policy snapshot and decision audit

description: Generic cross-industry review fact (requirement / technical / compliance / contract / DFM). Industry packages attach a 1:1 sidecar such as crm_review_pcba_dfm.
semantic_description: A generic review record shared across industries. PCBA DFM review is one industry implementation that links 1:1 via crm_review_common_id. Common layer owns reviewer, status, priority, account and request context; the industry sidecar owns industry-specific review fields.
lifecycle_description: pending -> in_review -> passed / conditional / failed / cancelled

description: Generic cross-industry risk item. Industry packages attach a 1:1 sidecar such as crm_risk_pcba_dfm.
semantic_description: A generic risk record shared across industries (technical / commercial / delivery / compliance / quality / supply). The common layer owns severity, status, owner and context; industry sidecars own industry-specific risk facts.
lifecycle_description: open -> mitigating -> accepted / mitigated / resolved / closed

description: Generic cross-industry clarification thread. Industry packages attach a 1:1 sidecar such as crm_clarification_pcba_dfm.
semantic_description: A generic clarification record shared across industries (customer / internal / supplier / compliance). The common layer owns status, priority, owner and context; industry sidecars own industry-specific clarification facts.
lifecycle_description: pending -> awaiting_customer -> customer_replied -> resolved / cancelled

description: Command-owned immutable file package whose SHA-256 binds customer confirmation to exact platform file bytes.
semantic_description: Immutable File Package evidence created by the QDP writer from verified platform file bytes and server metadata.
lifecycle_description: Created as confirmed evidence; replacement creates a new File Package record.

description: Command-owned immutable Requirement Version bound to one Customer Request snapshot and File Package Hash.
semantic_description: Immutable Requirement Version evidence used by QDP release; it freezes the accepted Customer Request row version, request snapshot and exact File Package Hash.
lifecycle_description: This slice records Customer Confirmed versions; later changes create a new version and supersede through QDP release lineage.

description: Immutable customer confirmation evidence binding an exact Requirement Version to an exact File Package Hash.
semantic_description: Immutable confirmation chain with customer actor, instant and external evidence reference; both Requirement Version pid and File Package Hash must match the QDP snapshot.
lifecycle_description: Confirmed evidence is immutable; withdrawal or new customer facts require a new Requirement Version and confirmation.

description: Command-owned QDP revision with controlled Draft, Compiling, Validation Failed, Review, Released and Superseded lifecycle
semantic_description: A command-owned QDP revision under a stable CRM Customer Request. Content and source fields are sole-writer facts and remain frozen; only exact lifecycle commands may advance status evidence. Industry plugins retain only this revision pid plus their own sidecar facts.
lifecycle_description: Draft -> Compiling -> Validation Failed / Ready for Review -> Released -> Superseded. Published content changes always create a new numbered QDP revision; only async compilation and lifecycle evidence may change on an existing record.

description: Configures lead-pool membership, claim limits, cooldowns and automatic recycling.
semantic_description: A governed shared lead pool. Members may see and claim available pool items; administrators may assign them and maintain policy. Capacity, daily limits and cooldowns are enforced by the command handler.
lifecycle_description: Enabled <-> Disabled. A pool with available items cannot be deleted.

description: One ordered time condition evaluated by a lead pool automatic recycle policy.
semantic_description: An operator-managed Cordys-parity recycle condition. Active rules are grouped by pool and evaluated using the pool's ALL/ANY match mode; relative-day and fixed-time conditions can inspect pool entry, claim, or last-activity time.
lifecycle_description: Active <-> Inactive. Inactive rules remain auditable but do not participate in scheduled or manual recycle evaluation.

description: Maximum concurrently owned open leads for one sales user.
semantic_description: Per-user lead ownership capacity used by claim and manager assignment. A missing active record means unlimited capacity; duplicate active user configurations are rejected by the unique user key.
lifecycle_description: Active or inactive capacity configuration.

description: Command-owned operational projection of one lead entering, leaving or being recycled into a pool.
semantic_description: Concurrency-safe pool projection. The unique lead key and available-to-claim compare-and-set prevent two users claiming the same lead. Snapshot fields keep the shared queue readable without weakening ordinary lead owner data scope.
lifecycle_description: Available -> Claiming -> Claimed / Assigned. Automatic recycle acquires Recycling, stale recovery alternates Recycling <-> Recycling Retry as a fenced lease, and only a fully completed re-entry returns the same item to Available.

description: Command-owned per-pool, per-user, per-day claim counter.
semantic_description: Atomic daily claim counter bounded by the pool limit snapshot.
lifecycle_description: One immutable identity per pool-user-local-date; the claim counter only increases.

description: Immutable audit evidence for move, claim, assign and automatic recycle events.
semantic_description: Append-only lead ownership history recording pool, previous owner, next owner, actor, reason and timestamp for every governed transition.
lifecycle_description: Append-only evidence; records are never edited or deleted.

description: Configures customer-pool membership, claim limits, cooldowns and automatic recycling.
semantic_description: A governed shared customer pool. Members may see and claim available customers; administrators may assign them and maintain policy. Capacity, daily limits and cooldowns are enforced atomically.
lifecycle_description: Enabled <-> Disabled. A pool with available customers cannot be deleted.

description: One ordered time condition evaluated by a customer-pool automatic recycle policy.
semantic_description: An operator-managed recycle condition. Active rules are grouped by pool and evaluated using the pool ALL/ANY match mode against entry, claim or last-activity time.
lifecycle_description: Active <-> Inactive. Inactive rules remain auditable but do not participate in scheduled or manual recycle evaluation.

description: Maximum concurrently owned active customers for one sales user.
semantic_description: Per-user customer ownership capacity used by claim and manager assignment. A missing active record means unlimited capacity; duplicate active user configurations are rejected by the unique user key.
lifecycle_description: Active or inactive capacity configuration.

description: Command-owned operational projection of one customer entering, leaving or being recycled into a public pool.
semantic_description: Concurrency-safe public-pool projection. The unique account key and available-to-claim compare-and-set prevent two users claiming the same customer. Snapshot fields keep the shared queue readable without weakening ordinary customer owner data scope.
lifecycle_description: Available -> Claiming -> Claimed / Assigned. Automatic recycle uses a fenced lease and returns only fully completed re-entry to Available.

description: Command-owned per-pool, per-user, per-day customer claim counter.
semantic_description: Atomic daily customer claim counter bounded by the pool limit snapshot.
lifecycle_description: One immutable identity per pool-user-local-date; the claim counter only increases.

description: Append-only audit evidence for move, claim, assign and automatic recycle events; purged only with an explicitly authorized permanent customer deletion.
semantic_description: Append-only customer ownership history recording pool, previous owner, next owner, actor, reason and timestamp for every governed transition.
lifecycle_description: Append-only during the customer lifecycle; records are never edited and are deleted only as part of the parent customer's authorized permanent purge, matching CordysCRM deletion semantics.

description: Tenant-scoped opportunity stage presentation, order, probability and availability.
semantic_description: Administrator-owned stage catalogue consumed by opportunity close execution. Stable codes preserve integrations while labels, order, probability, rollback policy and availability remain tenant configurable.
lifecycle_description: ACTIVE <-> INACTIVE. Inactive configured terminal stages reject new close operations without rewriting historical opportunities.

description: Ordered structured validations evaluated before an opportunity is won or lost.
semantic_description: Tenant-scoped structured close validation. The runtime evaluates active rules in sequence; no executable expression or raw JSON is exposed to administrators.
lifecycle_description: ACTIVE <-> INACTIVE. Active rules are enforced transactionally by opportunity close; inactive rules remain auditable but are skipped.
